title: Von-Stauffenberg-Straße, Unterhaching
description:
The spacious shared room is located in a bright 4-room apartment, which has been recently renovated. While the apartment and furniture are no longer brand new, everything is in excellent condition. The room features its own balcony access, offering a nice space to relax.

The apartment is equipped with a shared washing machine, which is available for use between multiple tenants at a cost of €1.50 per wash, by reservation. The windows are fitted with both curtains and blinds, allowing you to adjust the light and privacy as needed.

There is a storage room in the hallway that offers additional space for personal belongings, shared with other flatmates. The kitchen is well-equipped, providing a great space for socializing. It includes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, hob, and basic kitchenware. The apartment also has a large cellar compartment for extra storage.

The rental price includes all utilities as well as fast WLAN.

Location Description for Von Staufenbergstraße 92, Unterhaching, Munich:
The apartment is located in the quiet, well-connected area of Unterhaching, just south of Munich. It’s within walking distance to the Unterhaching S-Bahn station, which provides fast access to central Munich (approx. 20 minutes). Additionally, there are bus stops nearby, offering further convenient public transportation options.

For daily needs, there are several supermarkets (e.g. Edeka, Rewe), cafes, and shops located within walking distance. The area is very residential, providing a calm and green environment, while also being just a short commute away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Munich. The nearby parks and green spaces are perfect for relaxing or outdoor activities.

In terms of amenities, you’ll find a variety of local services such as pharmacies, gyms, and restaurants within a few minutes’ walk. Whether you’re looking for a quiet suburban lifestyle with great transport links or a more active, urban vibe, this location offers the best of both worlds.

As a professional co-living provider, we carefully match tenants to ensure a harmonious living experience. We look forward to hearing from you! :)

title: Bussardstraße, Unterhaching
description:
3,5 Zi. Designerwohnung, neu saniert mit großer Terrasse und mit Möglichkeit eine Garage zu mieten für maximal 3 Personen.

This beautiful apartment is quietly and idyllically located in the countryside and yet central. It has just been lovingly restored.

Equipment:
1 hallway
1 wardrobe
1 living room with wooden parquet
1 bedroom with wooden floorboards and four-poster bed
1 children/guest/study room with wooden floorboards
1 white kitchen with stove, oven, refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher,
1 large covered terrace

Location:
Quiet living and close to the city
The apartment is conveniently located near the S-Bahn Fasanengarten, close to Infineon.
Due to the edge of the forest you are surrounded by good fresh air, jogging is a real pleasure.
By car you can reach the center of Munich in 15 minutes, by train you can reach Marienplatz in 20 minutes.
A single garage would be possible to rent. this is lockable.
The apartment has been lovingly completely restored and has been tastefully furnished to a high standard.

Other features:
- First floor
- terrace
- Tiled floor, wooden floorboards
- ISDN connection
- fitted kitchen
 - fully furnished
- bathroom with shower, bathroom with tub, bathroom/WC separate
- suitable for shared flat
- DVB-T, cable connection
- first occupancy, luxurious
- elevator in the house
 
-1 parking space: garage (can be rented for an extra charge of 100 €)

***********

Diese schöne Wohnung liegt ruhig und idyllisch im Grünen und ist dennoch zentral. Sie wurde gerade liebevoll restauriert.

Ausstattung:
1 Flur
1 Garderobe
1 Wohnzimmer mit Holzparkett
1 Esszimmer
1 Schlafzimmer mit Holzdielen und Himmelbett
1 Kinder/Gäste/Arbeitszimmer mit Holzdielen
1 weiße Küche mit Herd, Backofen, Kühlschrank, Gefrierschrank, Geschirrspülmaschine, Waschmaschine
1 große Terrasse überdacht

Lage:
Ruhig wohnen und stadtnah
Die Wohnung liegt verkehrsgünstig an der S-Bahn Fasanengarten, Nähe Infineon.
Durch den Waldrand ist man von guter frischer Luft umgeben, joggen bereitet die wahre Freude.
Man gelangt mit dem Auto in 15 Minuten das Münchner Stadtzentrum, mit der Bahn ist man in 20 Minuten am Marienplatz.
Eine Einzelgarage wäre möglich zu mieten. diese ist abschliessbar und kostet im Monat 100 Euro zusätzlich.
Die Wohnung wurde liebevoll komplett restauriert und wurde geschmackvoll hochwertig eingerichtet.

Weitere Merkmale:
- Erdgeschoss
- Terrasse
- Fliesenboden, Holzdielen
- ISDN-Anschluss
- Einbauküche
 - vollmöbliert
- Bad mit Dusche, Bad mit Wanne, Bad/WC getrennt
- WG-geeignet
- DVB-T, Kabelanschluss
- Erstbezug, luxuriös
- Personenaufzug im Haus
- nur für Nichtraucher
- leider sind Tiere im Haus nicht erlaubt
 
-1  Garage kann gegen einen Aufpreis von 100 € dazu gemietet werden

einmal im Monat kommt die Putzfee mit 4 Stunden für die Reinigung der wohnung. Dieser Service ist im Mietpreis inbegriffen.
